verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a first-party Batch API that processes groups of requests asynchronously, which directly addresses bulk operations across many items. The evidence is a single summary line, so the depth and extent of the feature are unproven. Missing for 10: details on batch input format, size limits, job status tracking and result retrieval, pricing or discount specifics, and any hands-on or community corroboration of batch use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results
